errors.description: The fetch tool takes an article title or /wiki/ URL and returns plain-text extracts without tables; the searcher repeatedly passes index.php?action=raw, mobile and ?action=render URLs that can only return 404.
Instructs the same unsupported URL routes and mirror sites, and sets a verification bar ('quote the table row, do not guess a number') that the tool cannot meet.
Has fetched the Mongolia article (t=34), which states Mongolia is 'the 18th-largest country in the world', but reports 'could not get the rank' and frames the figure as unusable.
The re-planned fact sheet records '18th-largest' but discounts it as 'a country-only statement from a different article' and never dispatches a check; from here on no agent is instructed again.
Fact sheet rewritten 20 times (t=44…220) with growing speculation about Antarctica and Greenland rows; no tool call after t=34.
Final answer: 'my best estimate from memory is 19' and 'no tool ever ran', contradicting the fetches at t=15, 27 and 34.
